Method of Attack: Requires elevated pre-conditions for an attacker to exploit successfully
Allows code execution if an attacker controls and modifies the logging configuration file to point to a remote URI data source to load arbitrary Java code
Attack Vector: Modification of the logging configuration file to point to a remote URI data source
Exploitation of JNDI data source in the configuration file
Indicators of Compromise: Leaked details of the vulnerability on Twitter and GitHub
Proof of concept of the vulnerability shared before official disclosure
